description: An organism developed under a variable resource regime, later assessed against a fixed reference population. The question is whether measured differences are properties of the organism or of its relation to the environment it calibrated to.
open_questions: is a flat response a loss of discrimination or a shift of allocation
what was the organism calibrating to
does apparent deficit reverse when items come from the other domain
how tightly could the loop close, given the latency actually available
does confidence decouple from accuracy while every state variable reads nominal
what does the environment's own variance structure look like
which measured differences reverse if the reference population is changed
